method: deterministic physics tests; positions set deliberately to isolate contacts

checks.name: three selectable levels; 300 timer; 17 canopies, four lifts, 23 coins, two winged enemies
tree canopy catches a fall, but lets a jump through its underside
horizontal lift carries idle rider without sliding off
vertical lift carries rider and reverses without wrapping or dropping them
jump releases moving lift; walking past its edge falls normally
red Koopa patrols treetop instead of walking off
flying Koopa oscillates, first stomp removes wings, next stomp produces shell
checkpoint respawn is on safe high canopy and restores protection
single question block yields real power-up and can be hit from beneath
old underground looping lifts retain their original axes and wrap
